# BESTAR METAL

> BESTAR METAL is the brand of Shenzhen Bestar Tek Co. Ltd. It supports OEM and ODM custom metal product development, prototyping and manufacturing for overseas B2B customers, based in Dongguan, Guangdong, China. Visuals outside the Manufacturing page are conceptual illustrations, not photos of specific customer projects.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://bestarmetal.com/): OEM/ODM overview and buyer questions
- [Products](https://bestarmetal.com/products.html): customization possibilities by category
- [Design & Engineering](https://bestarmetal.com/design-engineering.html): six-stage process from idea to production
- [Manufacturing](https://bestarmetal.com/manufacturing.html): processes, materials, finishes and quality control
- [Prototyping](https://bestarmetal.com/prototyping.html): prototypes and small batches; MOQ, costs and lead time evaluated per project
- [Industries](https://bestarmetal.com/industries.html)
- [About](https://bestarmetal.com/about.html)
- [Contact](https://bestarmetal.com/contact.html): marketing@bestarmetal.com, WhatsApp +86 134 7614 4359
